Bid Summary.value: Dallas ISD’s RFP JA-207652, “Student and Staff Computing Devices,” seeks student Chromebooks, Windows laptops and tablets, staff laptops and desktops, and touch/non-touch monitors; proposed device specifications must include make and model in the page 36 response-value field. Proposals are due July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST, with electronic or manual submission permitted, although the electronic channel is not identified; fax and email submissions are not accepted. Manual submissions require one original hard copy in a sealed envelope addressed to Dallas ISD Procurement Services, 9400 N Central Expwy, Ste 1510, Attn: Staff Member and BID NUMBER, Dallas, TX 75231. The initial agreement is three years, with two mutually agreed one-year extensions, and deliveries must be scheduled with Dallas ISD ED TECH rather than against a fixed delivery date. A highly encouraged pre-bid meeting is scheduled for June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via Microsoft Teams. Required proposal documentation includes signed Addenda 1 and 2, pertinent product literature, completed M/WBE forms, three qualifying business references, Form 1295 unless publicly traded, and applicable reseller and EDGAR/FEMA certifications.
